billing.task: Implement billing and revenue reporting; own billing.py and new component tests.

booking.task: Build the customer booking flow; own booking.py and new component tests.

delivery.task: Implement delivery management; own delivery.py and new component tests.

notifications.task: Implement customer notifications: confirmation(email, delivery_id), input validation, no outbound email or money/refund calculations.

events.author: booking
events.body: Proposed revision 1: booking_request(total_cents, customer, destination) returns exactly {total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str} for create_delivery(**payload). Reject bool/non-int/negative total_cents with ValueError; zero accepted. Reject non-string or whitespace-only customer/destination; strip surrounding whitespace in returned strings. Browser POST /book with this shape; displays returned delivery_id, status, total_cents and refund_cents without computing policy. Please agree or suggest adjustment and confirm response fields.

events.author: billing
events.body: Propose revision 1 public interface: delivery.get_delivery_records() returns a flat list[dict], [] when empty. Each record includes total_cents and refund_cents as nonnegative integer cents (bool excluded), refund_cents <= total_cents, and status 'confirmed' or 'cancelled'; extra fields permitted. billing.summarize_records(records) iterates this list directly, sums actual total_cents - refund_cents regardless of status, counts confirmed/cancelled, returns {'revenue_cents': int, 'confirmed': int, 'cancelled': int}. revenue_report() calls get_delivery_records(). Billing validates shape/amounts/status. Please agree exact revision or propose needed changes.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Revision 1: retain confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str. Validate email as a plain nonempty address with one @, no whitespace/control characters, and a domain with nonempty dot-separated labels; delivery_id must be a positive int excluding bool. Invalid inputs raise ValueError. Return 'Delivery {delivery_id} confirmed for {email}.' No delivery lookup, outbound email, money amounts, or refund calculations. Is this compatible with booking? Please explicitly agree to revision 1 or propose changes.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implementing existing confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str; positive integer ID excluding bool, syntactic email validation, ValueError for invalid input. Message includes ID/email only; no delivery lookup or financial data. Please flag any incompatible ID assumption.

events.author: delivery
events.body: On cancellation persist refund_cents=total_cents; confirmed records start refund_cents=0. Repeat cancellation returns the same saved record. Billing should subtract actual saved refund_cents.
events.source:
Cancellation saves refund_cents equal to total_cents.
Billing counts actual saved refunds; a fully refunded delivery contributes zero revenue.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implemented confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str in notifications.py per proposal 3 revision 1. Plain ASCII email syntax supports plus addressing and dotted domains; rejects whitespace/control characters, empty labels and malformed addresses. Positive int IDs exclude bool; invalid inputs raise ValueError. Exact output: 'Delivery {delivery_id} confirmed for {email}.' Local formatter only, no money/refund logic. Added tests/test_notifications.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 6 tests, including existing baseline, input rejection, and /notify dispatch. Booking agreement on proposal 3 revision 1 remains pending.

events.author: billing
events.body: Applied policy 5 in billing.py: revenue sums saved total_cents minus saved refund_cents and does not infer refund from status. Full refund contributes zero; partial saved refund contributes remaining cents. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed 9 tests, including fully refunded and partial refund component cases.

events.author: billing
events.body: Implemented proposal 2 revision 1 in billing.py. revenue_report calls imported get_delivery_records and summarize_records validates flat list/dictionaries, integer nonnegative amounts, refund <= total and confirmed/cancelled status. Added tests/test_billing.py; all 9 local tests pass. Awaiting Delivery exact revision agreement; local starter delivery getter already satisfies shape.

events.author: booking
events.body: Implemented proposal 1 revision 1 in booking.py. Form POSTs /book; textContent shows server delivery_id/status/total_cents/refund_cents, with pending/error states and no refund formula. Added tests/test_booking_component.py. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 7 passed, covering validation, route delegation via mock, response passthrough, and HTML assertions. Live delivery integration remains unverified because local delivery.py is a stub. Awaiting your agreement and response-field confirmation.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Agreed delivery-record proposal 2 revision 1 (flat list snapshots) and booking-request proposal 1 revision 1. Actual records will contain delivery_id, total_cents, customer, destination, status, refund_cents. create/get/cancel return copied record dict. Delivery validation uses ValueError for invalid input including bool/non-int cents or IDs; trims customer/destination. Unknown valid IDs raise KeyError. Implementing now.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 5 in delivery.py: confirmed records save refund_cents=0; cancellation persists refund_cents=total_cents and cancelled status. Repeated cancellation returns the same saved values. Component tests verify zero and positive totals and cancellation snapshot isolation.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Implemented delivery.py per agreed proposal 2 revision 1 and booking proposal 1 revision 1. get_delivery_records() returns flat list[dict] copied snapshots; fields delivery_id,total_cents,customer,destination,status,refund_cents. create/get/cancel return copied records, positive IDs, validation and full saved refund. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v: 5 local tests pass (baseline + 4 delivery tests). Peer component implementations are not present in this workspace, so integrated booking/billing tests have not run here.

events.author: booking
events.body: Booking proposal 1 revision 1 now mutually agreed; confirmed your response fields match UI. Final local suite: 8 tests passed via python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Includes actual inline JS executed under Node with mocked DOM/fetch, checking POST body, arbitrary server refund 37 on total 100, returned status, HTTP/network errors and button reset. Route integration uses mocked create_delivery; peer implementation is not present locally, so no end-to-end delivery claim.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Interpreting four credits as 400 cents: cancellation now saves refund_cents=max(total_cents-400, 0), retaining min(total_cents,400). This supersedes full-refund policy 5. Repeated cancellation remains idempotent. Billing continues using actual saved refund_cents, so cancelled revenue retains the fee.
events.source: When a delivery is cancelled, keep a four-credit cancellation fee and refund the rest, never below zero.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 17 revision 2 in delivery.py: CANCELLATION_FEE_CENTS=400; first cancellation saves max(total_cents-400,0), repeated cancellation preserves saved refund. Updated tests cover totals 0,100,399,400,401,1250 with refunds 0,0,0,0,1,850 and snapshot isolation. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 5 local tests.

events.author: billing
events.body: Applied policy 17 revision 2. Billing continues subtracting actual saved refund_cents; no production calculation change needed. Added test_saved_cancellation_fee_policy exercising revenue_report with saved (total,refund,revenue) cents: (0,0,0),(100,0,100),(399,0,399),(400,0,400),(401,1,400),(1250,850,400). All 10 local tests pass via python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Tests mock saved Delivery records; cross-workspace integration was not run. Acknowledged delivery-record proposal 2 revision 1 is now agreed by both participants.
